description: This file implements a web worker module for handling file storage operations using the File System Access API and IndexedDB, including classes and functions for managing file chunks, metadata, and inter-thread communication.

classes.name: OriginPrivateFileStore
classes.description: A class managing file storage, chunk reading/writing, and metadata using File System Access API and IndexedDB.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes a new file store in a specified directory.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all files and metadata in the store.

methods.name: writeChunk
methods.description: Writes a data chunk to the directory.

methods.name: chunkSize
methods.description: Gets the size of a data chunk.

methods.name: listChunks
methods.description: Lists chunks with a specific prefix.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all entries in the directory.

methods.name: safeOp
methods.description: Ensures safe concurrent operations on chunks.
